name: Calendar Manager
description: Manage calendar events stored as RFC 5545 .ics files (base path via CALENDAR_BASE_PATH, default /tmp/stage7-calendars). Create, update, list, delete, export, and check availability of events. No operator credentials required.

calendarPath.description: Calendar .ics file name (must end in .ics; defaults to default.ics)

summary.description: Event summary/title (required for create; used as a lookup key for update if uid is omitted)

start.description: Event start time as an ISO 8601 string (required for create; used as windowStart for check_availability if windowStart is omitted)

end.description: Event end time as an ISO 8601 string

durationMinutes.description: Event duration in minutes (used when end is omitted)

uid.description: Event UID (required for update and delete)

rangeStart.description: Filter events ending at or after this ISO date (for list)

rangeEnd.description: Filter events starting at or before this ISO date (for list)

items.description: Known busy intervals to mark as occupied (for check_availability)

ics.description: Serialized ICS document (for list and export)

error.description: Error message, if the action failed
